Website privacy

How this website uses browser storage and external links.

Updated October 21, 2026.

Browser preferences

The site saves your selected color or holiday theme in your browser’s local storage. You can remove that preference by clearing this site’s browser data. No account is required to browse.

Site features

This version contains no website contact form, advertising tracker, or analytics script added by Purple Dragon Foundation. Hosting providers may process standard request information to deliver and protect the site.

External services

GitHub screenshots on project pages load from GitHub’s image hosting. Following download, music, Discord, or profile links opens an external service, which has its own privacy policy. Email links open your email application; information you send is used to respond to your inquiry.

Software privacy

This page describes the website. Each tool may have different behavior and integrations. Read that project’s documentation before using it.

Questions: kyle@purpledragonfoundationltd.xyz.
